verdict.rationale: Vercel's docs say connecting GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket deploys on every push with a preview URL for every branch, plus automatic preview environments for testing before production [vercel-docs-27, vercel-docs-1]. Supporting features for those previews are also documented: comments [vercel-docs-8], access protection [vercel-docs-26] and preview-specific environment variables [vercel-docs-23]. Missing for 10: explicit documentation tying previews to pull requests specifically (e.g., the preview URL posted on the PR), and independent or hands-on corroboration that previews work as claimed.
